packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript below 7: TS 7 ships no JS compiler API (the package exports only lib/version.cjs), so ts-loader, ts-jest (peer typescript <7) and typescript-eslint (peer typescript <6.1) cannot run on it.

Hold ESLint at 8: eslint-config-airbnb 19 (peer eslint ^7 || ^8) and eslint-plugin-import/react/jsx-a11y do not support ESLint 10, and ESLint 9+ needs a flat-config rewrite that replaces the airbnb preset.
Hold monaco-languageclient at 8: version 9+ requires the @codingame/monaco-vscode-api service stack (v11 pins vscode-api 37) and replacing the @monaco-editor/react editor integration.
Hold vscode-languageclient at 9 to match monaco-languageclient 8, which depends on vscode-languageclient ~9.0.1 (CloseAction/ErrorAction must come from the same copy).

Hold the geode Go driver below 0.2: geodedb.com/geode 0.2.x targets engine 0.8.18, and against Geode v0.5.15 (the minimum this UI supports and the version the e2e stack runs) every connection it opens and closes is leaked by the engine, which stops answering HELLO after about 16 of them. Each login opens one, so logins start failing and the login limiter locks the account (429 user_locked). v0.1.28 runs 40+ connect/close cycles cleanly.
